Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.quest

Class QuestLog

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.quest.QuestLog
public class QuestLog extends Object
All quests in a run, plus the small amount of extra state they need. Progress is recomputed from the game state once per turn by update(GameSession).
